---
title: "D3 Visualization"
toc: false
---

This interactive waffle chart is built with **React + D3** and embedded via an iframe. Each square represents one penguin, colored by species and grouped by island. Hover over species labels or island panels to highlight.

```{=html}
<iframe
  src="react-chart/dist/index.html"
  width="100%"
  height="700"
  style="border:none;"
></iframe>
```
